longDescription:
## Purpose

The PDP Ambiendo MVP template provides a complete, production-ready product detail page implementation that combines all essential e-commerce elements. It enables customers to view comprehensive product information, select variants, and complete purchases while discovering related products and promotional content.

## Use Cases

- Displaying product name, price, description, and high-quality images
- Navigating through product images with gallery and lightbox
- Selecting product variants and quantity with add-to-cart functionality
- Showing stock availability and estimated delivery time
- Featuring related products and customizable content areas

## Design Rationale

The template follows proven e-commerce patterns with the image gallery and buy box as primary focus areas above the fold. The accordion pattern for product details keeps the page scannable while providing access to comprehensive information. Content slots enable merchandising flexibility through category-specific or brand-specific promotions. The related products section supports cross-selling while the newsletter and footer integration completes the page experience.
shortDescription: Production-ready template combining all essential e-commerce elements. Displays product name, price, description with collapsible accordion for details. Shows stock availability and estimated delivery time. Follows proven e-commerce patterns with primary focus areas above the fold. Supports cross-selling through merchandising flexibility with category-specific or brand-specific promotions.
